messages:
Maya S: Heads-up  planning a gentle deprecation for the v1 chat/completions endpoint next release. We'll swap the default model alias and land v2 SDK breaking-change docs. Need owners for: migration guide, snippet updates, redirect map, and smoke tests.

Dylan T: I can draft the migration tutorial. Thinking sections: Why the change, quick command to upgrade, deep-dive on behavioral diffs, and upgrade checklist.

Priya N: I'll take snippets for python/js/go and also prepare a short compatibility table showing old->new call shapes.

Maya S: Concrete renames: endpoint `chat.completions` -> `chat.generate`; SDK method `client.chat.create` -> `client.chat.generate`; param `prompt` stays but `temperature` clamp changed default (0.7 -> 0.6). Call out default change.

Omar: For model aliases, we'll move `redwood-chat` -> `redwood-chat-v2` as the default. Existing pinned customers shouldn't be affected but add guidance for Dedicated: how to pin older alias.

Dylan T: Example quick diff for docs (we'll show side-by-side):
```js
// v1 (legacy)
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat', messages: [...] })
// v2 (new)
await client.chat.generate({ model: 'redwood-chat-v2', messages: [...], temperature: 0.6 })
```

Priya N: One more: the v2 SDK now throws `DEPRECATED_ENDPOINT` warning header when calling v1. We'll document how to detect and surface that in server logs.

Maya S: Redirects: plan to add soft redirects from /docs/api/chat/completions to /docs/api/chat/generate with 302 for 72h, then 301. Need infra to schedule TTL reduce.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-2044 for CDN TTL update and redirect configuration. ETA 36h.

Dylan T: Smoke tests: small suite that runs both v1 and v2 flows against staging and asserts identical high-level fields (id, choices[], finish_reason) and that differences are documented. Also check the warning header for v1.

Priya N: I'll add a GH Action `snippet-compat` that lints and runs snippets against staging. docs-ci: will that auto-block?

docs-ci: Yes  `snippet-compat` will be required for `release:candidate` label. Failures block merge.

Omar: Console banner: product wants a short banner on the Chat docs pages and Console feature card linking to migration guide. I'll submit a request; product will add via ticket.

Maya S: Communication plan: internal deprecation note Thurs, public deprecation + blog Fri 9:00 PT (same time as redirect flip). We should coordinate PRs to land before Tue EOD to get a full week of watch windows.

Dylan T: CLI migration helper proposed: `rw migrate-chat --from chat.completions --to chat.generate --dry-run`. We'll include a sample tokenized output and recommended steps to update client code.

Priya N: Edge case note  customers using legacy streaming framing in v1: add small migration appendix showing how to migrate framed events to new SSE-based stream.

Maya S: Action owners summary:
- Dylan: migration guide + changelog blurb + comms draft
- Priya: code snippets + GH Action `snippet-compat`
- Omar: redirects + infra ticket + Dedicated pinning note
- infra-bot: INF-2044 created

release-coordinator: Timeline pinned: PRs merged by Tue EOD, snippet CI green by Wed AM, staging deploy Wed PM, redirects soft flip Fri 09:00 PT -> hard flip 72h later.

Dylan T: I'll add a small FAQ entry: "What if my app depends on old temperature default?" with recommended explicit temperature setting and example.

Priya N: Also including sample rollback commands for the Console team in case of regressions.

Maya S: Please tag PRs with `docs:migration` and `release:candidate`. Keep changes minimal  link to deeper explainer rather than duplicating long behavior docs.

infra-bot: Staging deploy scheduled at 3090001500 for docs.

Dylan T: I'll open the initial PR now and ping reviewers. If anything blocks, escalate to release channel.

Maya S: Thanks team. We'll use this thread for follow-ups and to paste smoke test outputs. :rocket:
